name: biano
description: Search furniture and home decor offers of many e-shops on Biano, compare offers, see 3D models, redesign a room with the Biano AI designer and get plant care advice from Biano's plant guide.

interface.longDescription: Biano helps you furnish your home. Describe what you are looking for and the assistant searches the offers of furniture and home decor e-shops on Biano: by category, size in centimetres, colour, material and price. It shows product cards with photos, compares the offers of one product across e-shops, and shows a 3D model where the product has one. Upload a photo of your room and the Biano AI designer redesigns it, then finds products that fit the new look. It also answers plant care questions from Biano's plant guide: light, watering, a care calendar and whether a plant is safe for pets, with products for it. You buy on the e-shop's own website. Signing in with a Biano account is required.
capabilities: Compare the offers of a product across e-shops
Redesign a room from a photo with the AI designer
Edit a design: another style, remove or change an object, place a product
Find photos of furnished rooms and magazine articles
Keep favourite products and a product comparison
Watch a product's price after you confirm it
Answer plant care questions from Biano's plant guide, with photo credits and pet safety
defaultPrompt: Find a grey corner sofa up to 240 cm wide
Show me a 160 x 200 cm oak bed and the shops that sell it
Redesign my living room in a Scandinavian style

positive.description: Search with category, colour and price filters (biano.cz)
positive.prompt: Najdi mi šedou rohovou sedačku do 15 000 Kč.
positive.expected_behavior: search_products with the corner sofa category, the grey colour ID and priceTo 15000; a carousel of grey corner sofas, all at most 15,000 CZK.

positive.description: Compare the offers of one product and name the shop with the best price (biano.cz)
positive.prompt: Find a 160 x 200 cm double bed on Biano that several shops sell and tell me where it is cheapest, including coupons.
positive.expected_behavior: get_product on a bed from the results; the answer names the e-shop with the lowest bestPrice and its coupon code if there is one, and the offers widget shows the shops sorted by the best price.

positive.description: Redesign a room from an attached photo with the AI designer and shop the look (biano.cz, attach a JPEG photo of a living room)
positive.prompt: Here's a photo of my living room. Make it Scandinavian with light wood and show me where to buy the furniture.
positive.expected_behavior: design_room with the attached photo and a Scandinavian prompt (get_design polls while the design is still running); the designer widget shows before/after and shop-the-look carousels, which the widget fills through search_products.

positive.description: Find sofas, like one, add two to the comparison and show it (biano.cz)
positive.prompt: Najdi mi šedé rohové sedačky na Bianu. První z nich mi ulož do oblíbených a první dvě mi dej do porovnání, ať je vidím vedle sebe.
positive.tools_triggered: find_categories, get_filters, search_products, like_product, add_to_comparison, get_comparison
positive.expected_behavior: search_products finds grey corner sofas; like_product for the first result, add_to_comparison for the first two, then get_comparison; the comparison block shows them side by side with the differing parameters highlighted. Nothing else is liked or compared.

positive.description: Find a sofa and set a price watchdog that the shopper confirms (biano.cz)
positive.prompt: Najdi mi šedou rohovou sedačku na Bianu a hlídej mi cenu té první, dej mi vědět, až zlevní aspoň o 10 %.
positive.expected_behavior: search_products finds grey corner sofas; set_watchdog with the first result and a targetPrice about 10 % below its current price answers needs_confirmation; the watchdog block shows the product, the current and target price and the masked e-mail with Confirm. The assistant asks the shopper to confirm and does not call set_watchdog again on its own; nothing is set before Confirm.

negative.description: General interior style knowledge, no tool needed
negative.prompt: What is the difference between Scandinavian and Japandi interior style?
negative.expected_behavior: Answered from general knowledge, no tool call.

negative.description: A product category Biano does not cover (electronics)
negative.prompt: Recommend me a good laptop for programming under 1,000 euros.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call: Biano is furniture and home decor only.

negative.description: DIY repair advice, no shopping intent
negative.prompt: How do I fix a wobbly table leg myself?
negative.expected_behavior: Answered from general knowledge, no tool call.

review.commerce_description: Biano does not sell products or take payments. The app shows offers of e-shops; every offer button opens the e-shop's own website through Biano's click counter, where the user buys.

publication.release_notes: Biano's plant guide: find house and garden plants by name or by their needs (indoor, shade, safe for pets, the month to sow or bloom), see a plant's care, its care calendar for your country's climate and whether it is safe for pets, and the pots and other products for it. Every plant photo shows its author.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Nábytek z mnoha e-shopů
cs-CZ.description: Biano vám pomůže zařídit domov. Popište, co hledáte, a asistent prohledá nabídky e-shopů s nábytkem a bytovými doplňky na Biano: podle kategorie, rozměrů v centimetrech, barvy, materiálu a ceny. Ukáže produktové karty s fotkami, porovná nabídky jednoho produktu napříč e-shopy a u produktů, které ho mají, i 3D model. Nahrajte fotku pokoje a AI designer Biano ho přestyluje a najde produkty, které se k novému vzhledu hodí. Odpoví také na otázky o péči o rostliny z průvodce rostlinami Biano: světlo, zálivka, kalendář péče a zda je rostlina bezpečná pro zvířata, včetně produktů k ní. Nakupujete přímo na webu e-shopu. Je potřeba přihlášení účtem Biano.

sk-SK.subtitle: Nábytok z mnohých e-shopov
sk-SK.description: Biano vám pomôže zariadiť domov. Opíšte, čo hľadáte, a asistent prehľadá ponuky e-shopov s nábytkom a bytovými doplnkami na Biano: podľa kategórie, rozmerov v centimetroch, farby, materiálu a ceny. Ukáže produktové karty s fotkami, porovná ponuky jedného produktu naprieč e-shopmi a pri produktoch, ktoré ho majú, aj 3D model. Nahrajte fotku izby a AI dizajnér Biano ju prerobí a nájde produkty, ktoré sa k novému vzhľadu hodia. Odpovie aj na otázky o starostlivosti o rastliny zo sprievodcu rastlinami Biano: svetlo, polievanie, kalendár starostlivosti a či je rastlina bezpečná pre zvieratá, vrátane produktov k nej. Nakupujete priamo na webe e-shopu. Je potrebné prihlásenie účtom Biano.

pl-PL.subtitle: Meble z wielu sklepów online
pl-PL.description: Biano pomaga urządzić dom. Opisz, czego szukasz, a asystent przeszuka oferty sklepów z meblami i dekoracjami na Biano: według kategorii, wymiarów w centymetrach, koloru, materiału i ceny. Pokaże karty produktów ze zdjęciami, porówna oferty jednego produktu w różnych sklepach, a jeśli produkt go ma, także model 3D. Prześlij zdjęcie pokoju, a projektant AI Biano zaprojektuje go na nowo i znajdzie pasujące produkty. Odpowiada też na pytania o pielęgnację roślin z przewodnika po roślinach Biano: światło, podlewanie, kalendarz pielęgnacji i to, czy roślina jest bezpieczna dla zwierząt, wraz z produktami do niej. Kupujesz bezpośrednio na stronie sklepu. Wymagane jest logowanie kontem Biano.

hu-HU.subtitle: Bútorok sok webáruházból
hu-HU.description: A Biano segít berendezni az otthonodat. Írd le, mit keresel, és az asszisztens átnézi a bútor- és lakberendezési webáruházak ajánlatait a Bianón: kategória, centiméteres méret, szín, anyag és ár szerint. Termékkártyákat mutat fotókkal, összeveti egy termék ajánlatait a webáruházak között, és ha a terméknek van, a 3D modelljét is megmutatja. Tölts fel egy fotót a szobádról, a Biano AI tervező újratervezi, és megkeresi az új stílushoz illő termékeket. A Biano növénykalauza alapján a növényápolási kérdésekre is válaszol: fény, öntözés, ápolási naptár, és hogy a növény biztonságos-e a háziállatok számára, a hozzá illő termékekkel együtt. A vásárlás a webáruház saját oldalán történik. Biano-fiókkal való bejelentkezés szükséges.

ro-RO.subtitle: Mobilă din multe magazine
ro-RO.description: Biano te ajută să îți amenajezi casa. Descrie ce cauți, iar asistentul caută în ofertele magazinelor online de mobilă și decorațiuni de pe Biano: după categorie, dimensiuni în centimetri, culoare, material și preț. Îți arată carduri de produs cu fotografii, compară ofertele unui produs între magazine și, unde există, îți arată modelul 3D. Încarcă o fotografie a camerei, iar designerul AI Biano o reamenajează și găsește produse potrivite noului aspect. Răspunde și la întrebări despre îngrijirea plantelor din ghidul de plante Biano: lumină, udare, un calendar de îngrijire și dacă planta este sigură pentru animale, cu produse potrivite pentru ea. Cumperi direct pe site-ul magazinului. Este necesară autentificarea cu un cont Biano.

bg-BG.subtitle: Мебели от много е-магазини
bg-BG.description: Biano ви помага да обзаведете дома си. Опишете какво търсите и асистентът претърсва офертите на онлайн магазините за мебели и декорация в Biano: по категория, размери в сантиметри, цвят, материал и цена. Показва продуктови карти със снимки, сравнява офертите за един продукт в различните магазини и показва 3D модел, когато продуктът има такъв. Качете снимка на стаята си и AI дизайнерът на Biano ще я преобзаведе и ще намери подходящи продукти. Отговаря и на въпроси за грижата за растения от ръководството за растения на Biano: светлина, поливане, календар за грижа и дали растението е безопасно за домашни любимци, с продукти за него. Купувате директно от сайта на магазина. Необходим е вход с акаунт в Biano.

el-GR.subtitle: Έπιπλα από πολλά e-shop
el-GR.description: Το Biano σας βοηθά να επιπλώσετε το σπίτι σας. Περιγράψτε τι ψάχνετε και ο βοηθός αναζητά τις προσφορές των ηλεκτρονικών καταστημάτων επίπλων και διακόσμησης στο Biano: ανά κατηγορία, διαστάσεις σε εκατοστά, χρώμα, υλικό και τιμή. Δείχνει κάρτες προϊόντων με φωτογραφίες, συγκρίνει τις προσφορές ενός προϊόντος σε διάφορα καταστήματα και δείχνει το τρισδιάστατο μοντέλο όπου υπάρχει. Ανεβάστε μια φωτογραφία του δωματίου σας και ο AI σχεδιαστής του Biano θα το ανασχεδιάσει και θα βρει προϊόντα που ταιριάζουν. Απαντά επίσης σε ερωτήσεις φροντίδας φυτών από τον οδηγό φυτών του Biano: φως, πότισμα, ημερολόγιο φροντίδας και αν το φυτό είναι ασφαλές για τα κατοικίδια, με προϊόντα για αυτό. Αγοράζετε απευθείας από τον ιστότοπο του καταστήματος. Απαιτείται σύνδεση με λογαριασμό Biano.

nl-NL.subtitle: Meubels van veel webshops
nl-NL.description: Biano helpt je je huis in te richten. Beschrijf wat je zoekt en de assistent doorzoekt het aanbod van webshops voor meubels en woonaccessoires op Biano: op categorie, afmetingen in centimeters, kleur, materiaal en prijs. Je ziet productkaarten met foto's, de aanbiedingen van één product bij verschillende webshops naast elkaar en, waar het product er een heeft, een 3D-model. Upload een foto van je kamer en de Biano AI-ontwerper richt hem opnieuw in en zoekt producten die bij de nieuwe look passen. Hij beantwoordt ook vragen over plantverzorging uit de plantengids van Biano: licht, water geven, een verzorgingskalender en of een plant veilig is voor huisdieren, met producten erbij. Je koopt op de website van de webshop zelf. Inloggen met een Biano-account is vereist.

pt-PT.subtitle: Móveis de muitas lojas online
pt-PT.description: O Biano ajuda-o a mobilar a sua casa. Descreva o que procura e o assistente pesquisa as ofertas das lojas online de móveis e decoração no Biano: por categoria, dimensões em centímetros, cor, material e preço. Mostra cartões de produto com fotografias, compara as ofertas de um produto entre lojas e, quando o produto o tem, mostra o modelo 3D. Carregue uma fotografia da sua divisão e o designer de IA do Biano redecora-a e encontra produtos que combinam com o novo visual. Também responde a perguntas sobre o cuidado de plantas a partir do guia de plantas do Biano: luz, rega, um calendário de cuidados e se a planta é segura para animais, com produtos para ela. Compra diretamente no site da loja. É necessário iniciar sessão com uma conta Biano.

it-IT.subtitle: Mobili da tanti negozi online
it-IT.description: Biano ti aiuta ad arredare casa. Descrivi cosa cerchi e l'assistente cerca tra le offerte dei negozi online di mobili e complementi d'arredo su Biano: per categoria, dimensioni in centimetri, colore, materiale e prezzo. Mostra schede prodotto con foto, confronta le offerte di un prodotto tra i diversi negozi e, se il prodotto lo ha, mostra il modello 3D. Carica una foto della tua stanza e il designer AI di Biano la riarreda e trova i prodotti adatti al nuovo stile. Risponde anche alle domande sulla cura delle piante dalla guida alle piante di Biano: luce, annaffiature, un calendario di cura e se la pianta è sicura per gli animali, con i prodotti adatti. Acquisti direttamente sul sito del negozio. È necessario accedere con un account Biano.

pt-BR.subtitle: Móveis de muitas lojas online
pt-BR.description: O Biano ajuda você a mobiliar sua casa. Descreva o que procura e o assistente pesquisa as ofertas das lojas online de móveis e decoração no Biano: por categoria, dimensões em centímetros, cor, material e preço. Mostra cards de produto com fotos, compara as ofertas de um produto entre lojas e, quando o produto tem, mostra o modelo 3D. Envie uma foto do seu cômodo e o designer de IA do Biano redecora o ambiente e encontra produtos que combinam com o novo visual. Também responde a perguntas sobre cuidados com plantas a partir do guia de plantas do Biano: luz, rega, um calendário de cuidados e se a planta é segura para pets, com produtos para ela. Você compra direto no site da loja. É preciso entrar com uma conta Biano.
